stem: After a canopy work day, one cultivar recovers normally while another shows repeated branch damage and delayed recovery under the same room conditions. What is the strongest handoff?
choices: Report the cultivar-specific response, exact work performed, damage frequency, and recovery observations so the work plan can be evaluated
Conclude the second cultivar should never be trained
Repeat the same work more aggressively
Remove the damaged plants from the work record
rationale: A cultivar-specific response is useful operational evidence. It should be documented for work-plan evaluation without making a universal conclusion from one event.
